name: Route 186 — Qawra ↔ Ta' Qali scheduled corridor
address: MPT's route page lists Qawra stop 952 and the directional Stadium stops at Ta' Qali (2194 / 6227). Route 186 runs between Buġibba and Rabat via Qawra, Mosta and Ta' Qali; the correct stop side depends on direction.
hours: MPT's checked route listing shows a scheduled frequency of every 30 minutes. At Qawra stop 952, the published Bugibba→Rabat schedule starts at 06:10 and ends at 21:38; use the live planner for the trip date and selected direction.
price range: MPT currently lists €2.00 winter / €2.50 summer for a day-route single valid for two hours; the October 2026 seasonal change date is not published.
description: Route 186 is the strongest public-bus candidate from Qawra to Ta' Qali: the operator lists Qawra and directional Ta' Qali Stadium stops on the same scheduled route. This does not confirm that Thunderpick's spectator entrance is at MFCC, that TWC admits the public, or that the Stadium stop is the best approach. Confirm the entrance, exact stop, walk and trip-day service before relying on it.
notes: The normal Rabat→Buġibba direction returns via St Paul's Bay and the Buġibba seafront rather than the Qawra seafront; MPT's current listing shows the last scheduled arrival at Buġibba Bay 1 at 21:26. Do not treat that as a guaranteed event-day connection to the hotel. MPT also lists an evening Route 186 detour toward Buġibba on 17 Oct, 19:00–midnight, skipping Gholja 2 through Targa; its effect on the exact TWC return stop is unresolved. Recheck live. Planner: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/tallinja-app/ · service updates: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/latest-service-updates/ · BLAST address source for a separate event: https://blast.tv/cs/news/malta-fan-guide · MPT route timetable: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/route/186/

name: Airport Direct TD1 — airport to the Qawra area
area: Malta International Airport ↔ Qawra / Buġibba ↔ Ċirkewwa
address: MIA bus terminal; MPT's route/stop listings show Qawra-area stops including stop 952. The exact stop and walk to AX ODYCY must be checked.
hours: MPT lists TD1 as hourly. Use the live timetable for the actual flight time; frequency is not a guarantee of a convenient connection.
price range: MPT currently lists €3.50 per passenger for TD1 without a qualifying Unlimited Travel Card; confirm the current fare and card terms before travel.
description: A faster airport-bus candidate than a multi-leg local-bus trip. MPT lists TD1 between the airport and the north of Malta, and the stop listing shows the route at Qawra stop 952. Check the route direction, the correct hotel-side stop and the walk with luggage before choosing it.
notes: MPT's Airport Direct page lists TD1 hourly, says Unlimited Travel Cards include Airport Direct, and lists the no-card TD1 price as €3.50. Check the exact pass/product and trip time in Tallinja; Malta International Airport's separate bus page lists TD1–TD4 but not TD5, whereas MPT's current Airport Direct page also lists TD5. name: MPT fares and visitor travel cards
address: Tickets may be purchased on buses; travel cards are sold through MPT offices, machines, retailers and the Tallinja app as specified by MPT.
hours: Fare rules and card availability can change; check the operator's current page before travel.
price range: Day-route single: €2.00 winter / €2.50 summer, valid for two hours (October 2026 boundary unconfirmed); Airport Direct: €3.50 on TD1 / €3 on other TD routes without an eligible Unlimited Travel Card; Explore Adult 7-day €25; Explore Flex 7-day €27.
description: MPT supports cash and contactless payment for single bus tickets. A seven-day card may be good value if the itinerary includes enough eligible bus trips, but the card types differ and route exclusions matter. Compare the current product terms with your actual itinerary instead of assuming every card covers every airport service.
notes: The current fare page's dated winter window ends 13 Jun 2026; it does not state when the 2026 summer/winter fare switches. The Airport Direct page says Unlimited Travel Cards include Airport Direct; confirm exact card eligibility and distinguish Airport Direct from Tallinja Direct. Airport Direct: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/other-services/airport-direct/

name: Tallinja app and live journey planner
address: Official Malta Public Transport website and mobile app; no physical visitor address.
hours: Live bus tracking, service alerts and journey planning are app features; mobile-data access and signal are not guaranteed.
price range: The app is offered for free; bus travel and optional card products are charged separately.
description: Use the operator's planner for a date-specific route, walking directions, estimated times, service alerts and live bus tracking. For the TWC journey, search both AX ODYCY-to-MFCC and the return separately, and recheck after any event-time change.
notes: The operator explicitly describes journey planning, live updates and service alerts. This improves planning but does not guarantee a particular bus will run or that the venue is open to spectators.
